parent_protocol.inherited: training, kernel, optimizer, initialization prior, temperature sets, objectives, fit selection, search, confirmation, final fitting, failures; all unchanged

family.name: diagonal_ghz_k4
family.model: one IQP circuit with diagonal-layer conditioning: theta(beta) = sum_{k<K} T_k(beta - 1) w_k, T_k Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind, w_k in R^136; beta in [0, 2] maps to x in [-1, 1]
family.role: secondary: cubic in beta, 544 parameters; with four training anchors equivalent to fitting each anchor and interpolating, the closest analogue of diagonal-layer conditioning in Liu et al.
family.input: parity encoder at fixed t=pi/2, condition independent; reference uniform on even-parity strings, so global spin-flip symmetry holds for every parameter value
family.initialization: w_0 ~ N(0, init_scale^2) elementwise from the paired parent initialization stream; w_k = 0 for k >= 1, so the initial law equals the constant-theta IQP of the other families
family.search_space: parent learning_rate, init_scale, b1, one_minus_beta2, schedule and kernel_pair with the parent ranges and priors; no encoder hyperparameter
family.ansatz: complete one- and two-body, 136 phases, no ancillas

randomness.fit_streams: parent namespace cw-parity-hpo-followup-20261009 and keys; target pools and fit streams pair with the shared_parity fits at every stage, repeat and start
randomness.sampler_keys: (sampler, diagonal_ghz_k4, random|tpe) in the parent namespace; independent of the samplers

stages: random 60 -> TPE 60 -> confirmation (3-4 candidates, 5 repeats x 3 starts) -> final (10 repeats x 3 starts)
execution: fits may be sharded across machines with identical source identity; recording, Optuna ask/tell and selection run once on the primary workspace
